hot-pink.$description: Oxblood. Resonant substitute for Epidemic Sound hot pink. Full-bleed chapter backgrounds only, never a small tint or button fill.

sun-yellow.$description: Sun Yellow. Decorative only. Not used as a section or CTA.

signal-blue.$description: Charcoal standing in for Epidemic Sound signal blue. Secondary dark chapter, not a candy accent.

leaf-green.$description: Leaf Green. Decorative only. Not a CTA.

ink-black.$description: Ink Black. Display type, icons, and the only filled CTA (ink stamp).

charcoal.$description: Charcoal. Dark surface, player, secondary dark text.

slate.$description: Slate. Body helper text and muted UI labels.

bone.$description: Bone. Warm editorial surface for rows, ghost buttons, and nav tint.

mist.$description: Mist. Cooler light surface for cards and disabled states.

stone.$description: Stone. Hairline dividers and disabled borders.

sand.$description: Sand. Warm wash and image placeholders.

inter.$description: Workhorse sans for body, nav, buttons, and functional UI.

sebentafont-custom-editorial-serif.$description: Public substitute for sebentaFont. Display and large headings only. Italic is the emphasis system.

hot-pink-block.$description: Oxblood full-bleed chapter. Substitutes Epidemic Sound hot pink.

signal-blue-block.$description: Charcoal full-bleed chapter. Substitutes Epidemic Sound signal blue.
